memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure-free for 3 months on current regimen; no adverse effects reported.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD; check serum sodium and creatinine; routine EEG in 6 months.
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Plaques on elbows and knees, mild scaling; PASI ~6.
  - Plan: Initiate clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically to affected areas; calcipotriol ointment OD; methotrexate 7.5 mg PO weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD; monitor LFT, CBC, creatinine.
Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure-free; mild morning drowsiness reported.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD; check serum sodium and creatinine; consider dose adjustment if somnolence persists.
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Plaques reduced, mild residual erythema; PASI ~3.
  - Plan: Increase methotrexate to 10 mg PO weekly; maintain folic acid 5 mg OD; continue topical steroids and calcipotriol; repeat LFT, CBC, creatinine in 4 weeks.
Due: Next review in 3 months.

memories.text: I’ve noticed my skin lesions are almost flat now, just occasional pink patches. No new seizures, and I feel energetic. I’m worried about the methotrexate pill causing nausea, but I haven’t vomited. Please advise if I can take it with food.
